scope: Additional primary literature on Irx5/Kcnd2, Slit2-associated ventricular CMs, trabecular versus VCS interpretation; excludes already known Costantini2005 and DeLaughter2016.
interpretation: Separate regional repolarization, rapid conduction-system overlap, and developmental trabecular maturation as competing or overlapping axes. RNA alone cannot establish physical location or conduction physiology.

sources.title: The trabecular and compact myocardium of adult vertebrate ventricles are transcriptionally similar despite morphological differences.
sources.authorString: Mulleners OJ, van der Maarel LE, Christoffels VM, Jensen B.
sources.evidence: Primary spatial and single-cell cross-species comparisons of embryonic/adult trabecular and compact myocardium.
findings: Embryonic mouse trabecular vs compact expression differs more than adult trabecular vs compact myocardium.
Adult differences were small and little conserved across sampled vertebrate species.
cautions: Embryonic anatomical programs do not automatically persist into adult CM transcriptional identity.
Does not refute rare conduction subtypes or all finer adult regional electrophysiology differences.

verification.text: Indexed primary abstract; full original methods not verified in this review

sources.title: Transcriptional regulation of the postnatal cardiac conduction system heterogeneity.
sources.authorString: Oh Y, Abid R, Dababneh S, Bakr M, Aslani T, Cook DP, Vanderhyden BC, Park JG, Munshi NV, Hui CC, Kim KH.
sources.evidence: P1/P2/P4 Cntn2 reporter-enriched mouse CM scRNA-seq, P4 GeoMx spatial transcriptomics, histology/FISH, neonatal CM TF overexpression.
findings: Slit2 and Sema3a are distal ventricular conduction-system markers in this reference.
Distal BB and Purkinje: Myl2/Myl3/Irx3/Gja5/Gja1/Slit2/Sema3a-positive; atrial Myl4/Myl7 low.
Mpped2, Scn10a and Nppa enriched distal VCS; Pcp4 throughout VCS with stronger His/BB signal.
Tbx3 and Irx3 activated Mpped2 and Slit2 in neonatal ventricular, but not atrial, CMs.
Irx3 overexpression activates Nppa, Scn10a, Gja5; Tbx3 coexpression reduces activation of these targets.
Mpped2 and NaV1.8 show somewhat broader endomyocardial distribution than reporter-labeled VCS.
Reporter-positive viable cells were 0.1-0.2% of all viable cardiomyocytes; enrichment pipeline is not a population census.
cautions: Directly relevant postnatal reference, but P1-P4 and reporter enrichment differ from P0/P7/P14/P21 unsorted nuclei.
Slit2 expression can reflect distal VCS overlap or broader endomyocardial regional programs, and is not unique Purkinje proof.
Scn10a short transcript predominates: gene-level detection does not establish full-length NaV1.8 channel.
No Irx5-specific mechanistic claim from this paper.

sources.title: Transcription factor ETV1 is essential for rapid conduction in the heart.
sources.authorString: Shekhar A, Lin X, Liu FY, Zhang J, Mo H, Bastarache L, Denny JC, Cox NJ, Delmar M, Roden DM, Fishman GI, Park DS.
sources.evidence: Mouse Etv1 loss-of-function and electrophysiology, developmental VCS analyses, NRG1 response and human phenome associations.
findings: ETV1 establishes fast-conduction physiology in pectinated atrial myocardium and ventricular conduction system.
ETV1 regulates Nkx2-5, Gja5 and Scn5a and affects sodium current heterogeneity.
cautions: Etv1 is not Purkinje-specific because atrial fast-conduction tissue also expresses it.
Need ventricular lineage confirmation and an independent VCS/Purkinje panel.

verification.text: Indexed primary abstract; full original methods not verified in this review

sources.title: Irx3 is required for postnatal maturation of the mouse ventricular conduction system.
sources.authorString: Kim KH, Rosen A, Hussein SM, Puviindran V, Korogyi AS, Chiarello C, Nagy A, Hui CC, Backx PH.
sources.evidence: Irx3 knockout mouse P0, P4 and adult VCS reporter morphology and ECG, plus functional transcriptional analysis.
findings: Mild VCS structural defects at P0 progressed to marked loss of fiber density/thickness and right bundle branch block by P4.
Progressive VCS hypoplasia associated with defective CM recruitment/maturation, rather than increased VCS apoptosis.
Irx3 promotes VCS-enriched transcripts targeted by Nkx2.5 and/or Tbx5.
cautions: Developmental transcriptional differences can encode VCS maturation across stages, not only stable mature identities.
Loss-of-function phenotypes do not show that a wild-type expression gradient alone measures conduction velocity.

sources.title: Cooperative and antagonistic roles for Irx3 and Irx5 in cardiac morphogenesis and postnatal physiology.
sources.authorString: Gaborit N, Sakuma R, Wylie JN, Kim KH, Zhang SS, Hui CC, Bruneau BG.
sources.evidence: Mouse Irx3/Irx5 combined loss and postnatal myocardial conditional perturbation.
findings: Irx3 and Irx5 have overlapping and distinct developmental domains.
Postnatal combined Irx3/Irx5 loss prolongs AV conduction and is associated in part with Nav1.5 activation changes.
Combined loss restores repolarization gradient altered in Irx5 mutants, showing non-additive regulatory interaction.
cautions: Irx5 repolarization and Irx3 rapid-conduction roles are related but distinct.
Irx5-high/Kcnd2-low in observational nuclei is consistent with a regional repolarization program, not direct functional proof or causal regulation per cluster.

verification.text: Indexed primary abstract; full original methods not verified in this review

sources.title: Iroquois homeobox gene 3 establishes fast conduction in the cardiac His-Purkinje network.
sources.authorString: Zhang SS, Kim KH, Rosen A, Smyth JW, Sakuma R, Delgado-Olguín P, Davis M, Chi NC, Puviindran V, Gaborit N, Sukonnik T, Wylie JN, Brand-Arzamendi K, Farman GP, Kim J, Rose RA, Marsden PA, Zhu Y, Zhou YQ, Miquerol L, Henkelman RM, Stainier DY, Shaw RM, Hui CC, Bruneau BG, Backx PH.
sources.evidence: Irx3 mouse loss-of-function, VCS localization, electrophysiology and transcriptional assays.
findings: Irx3 required for rapid His-Purkinje propagation.
Irx3 loss reduces Cx40/Gja5 and causes ectopic Cx43/Gja1 in proximal bundle branches.
Irx3 directly represses Gja1 and indirectly promotes Gja5.
cautions: Gja1 is region-specific, not uniformly absent across the whole distal VCS; interpret with the 2024 regional atlas.
Irx3 RNA expression alone does not identify anatomically verified Purkinje cells.

verification.text: Indexed primary abstract; full original methods not verified in this review

sources.title: Biphasic development of the mammalian ventricular conduction system.
sources.authorString: Miquerol L, Moreno-Rascon N, Beyer S, Dupays L, Meilhac SM, Buckingham ME, Franco D, Kelly RG.
sources.evidence: Clonal analysis in three-week-old mouse hearts with alpha-cardiac actin nlaacZ and Cx40-EGFP; Cre fate mapping.
findings: Conductive and working myocytes share progenitors.
Cx40-positive myocytes progressively restrict to conductive fate during development.
Lineage restriction is followed by limited expansion in the VCS.
cautions: Developmental Gja5 expression is broader than mature conduction fate.
Shared trabecular/VCS programs need not mean all cells in a cluster are mature Purkinje cells.

verification.text: Indexed primary abstract; full original methods not verified in this review

sources.title: Contactin-2 expression in the cardiac Purkinje fiber network.
sources.authorString: Pallante BA, Giovannone S, Fang-Yu L, Zhang J, Liu N, Kang G, Dun W, Boyden PA, Fishman GI.
sources.evidence: Murine Purkinje vs working-CM transcriptional profiling, anatomical colocalization, reporter cells with patch clamp/Ca transients; canine validation.
findings: Cntn2 highly enriched in Purkinje network compared with working ventricular CMs.
In the mouse ventricle Cntn2 localizes to subendocardial network coexpressing CCS-lacZ and Cx40.
Reporter-positive cells displayed Purkinje-like prolonged action potentials and frequent afterdepolarizations.
cautions: Marker validation strongest with anatomy plus physiological testing.
Sparse Cntn2 in snRNA-seq does not exclude conduction biology; a single detection does not establish identity.

verification.text: Indexed primary abstract; full original methods not verified in this review

analytical_tests: Within each age and sample, test coexpression of independent gene panels in individual cells, not only cluster means.
Report fraction detected and expression for each marker because ion-channel and adhesion gene dropout is common in nuclei.
Use sample-aware pseudobulk for group comparisons; inspect whether high-module cells recur across samples.
Map to the postnatal CCS reference cautiously given assay and age differences.
Use Xenium or RNAscope/anatomical localization for Slit2/Irx5/Kcnd2 plus multi-marker VCS confirmation; physiology is needed for actual conduction claims.
